name: Shopify Merge product sync Pipeline (GraphQL) - Process Product

parameters.content:
## Process Product (sub-workflow)

Extracted from **Shopify Merge product sync Pipeline (GraphQL)** to fix a confirmed n8n platform bug in the Loop Over Items (Split In Batches) node: when the same SplitInBatches node is triggered more than once within an execution (which is exactly what happened -- Process Each Product was fed once per sheet by the outer loop), its internal state goes stale after the first activation and every later activation silently processes almost nothing (confirmed live: 289 runs, only 2 produced output). n8n's own fix for this (PR #23775) was closed without being merged, so there's no version upgrade that resolves it.

This sub-workflow does the full per-product work -- create/update, image sync, collections, metafields, publish -- for exactly ONE item. The main pipeline calls it via an Execute Sub-workflow node in "Run once for each item" mode instead of using a second SplitInBatches node, which sidesteps the buggy code path entirely: each call is a fresh execution with its own clean state.

**One-time setup after importing both files:** open the main pipeline's "▶️ Process Product (per item)" node and select this workflow from the dropdown -- its ID doesn't exist yet at export time so it can't be pre-linked.
